text: 74-year-old male. The patient presents with sudden onset of abdominal pain around the umbilicus 16 hours ago, with recent history of hospitalization for an acute myocardial infarction a week ago. Reports several episodes of bloody loose bowel movements. Denies vomiting.

speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Mesenteric Ischemia secondary to recent Acute Myocardial Infarction (embolic source).

The patient's history of a myocardial infarction one week ago combined with sudden umbilical pain and bloody stools is highly suggestive of an embolic event to the mesenteric arteries. Please confirm if the pain has improved after defecation and if there are any other current symptoms like dizziness or fainting. REQUEST IMAGES: Abdominal_CTA.
